## Cyclops, Tartalo (CR 5)

This brutish humanoid stands nearly three times the height of a human, with a single eye glaring out beneath a beetling brow. It is dressed in rough sheepskins, but a gleaming gold ring adorns one of its fingers.  

**XP** 1,600  
NE Large humanoid (giant)  
**Init** +3; **Senses** low-light vision, scent; Perception +1  


**Defense**


**AC** 15, touch 8, flat-footed 15 (-1 Dex, +7 natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 84 (7d8+28)  
**Fort** +9, **Ref** +1, **Will** +3  
**Defensive Abilities** ferocity, rock catching; **DR** 5/piercing  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft.  
**Melee** spear +10 (2d6+7) or 2 slams +9 (1d8 +5)  
**Ranged** spear +4 (2d6+5) or rock +5 (2d8+7)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** rock throwing (120 ft.)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 21 Dex 8, **Con** 19, **Int** 6, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 12  
**Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +11; **CMD** 18  
**Feats** Cornugon Smash, Intimidating Prowess, Weapon Focus (spear), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative.*  
**Skills** Craft (jewelry) +10, Intimidate +14, Profession (shepherd) +5; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Craft (jewelry)  
**Languages** Common, Giant  
**SQ** cursed ring, poor depth perception  


**Special Abilities**


**Poor Depth Perception** Tartalo cyclops have difficulty with their depth perception suffering –4 to sight based perception checks and –4 on ranged attacks beyond 30 ft.  

**Cursed Ring (Su)** Tartalo cyclops forge a ring that they imbue with a captured spirit. Once per day, the tartalo cyclops can ask the ring for magical aid as a swift action to immediately cast aid, blood armor, or cure moderate wounds (CL 7). This does not provoke attacks of opportunity.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** temperate or warm hills or mountains  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or gang (3-5)  
**Treasure** standard (large spear, cursed ring, other treasure)
